tables.name: calibration_runs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE calibration_runs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_set_snapshots(id), config_bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, model_bundle_version TEXT NOT NULL, prompt_bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, run_type TEXT NOT NULL, random_seed INTEGER NOT NULL, split_manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, attempted_policies_json TEXT NOT NULL, selected_policy_json TEXT, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

indexes.name: idx_gold_annotation_one_active
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_gold_annotation_one_active ON gold_annotation_revisions(presented_record_id,reviewer_id,annotation_round) WHERE active=1

tables.name: gold_annotation_revisions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_annotation_revisions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, presented_record_id TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (annotation_round IN (1,2)), reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision_number INTEGER NOT NULL, label TEXT CHECK (label IN ('include','borderline','exclude')), education_centrality TEXT CHECK ( education_centrality IN ('core','substantial','incidental','none') ), economics_relevance TEXT CHECK ( economics_relevance IN ( 'economic_question','economic_method_only', 'adjacent_social_science','non_economic' ) ), evidence_sufficiency TEXT CHECK ( evidence_sufficiency IN ('sufficient','limited','insufficient') ), reviewer_confidence TEXT CHECK (reviewer_confidence IN ('high','medium','low')), reason_codes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', optional_notes TEXT, disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (disposition IN ('submitted','deferred')), marked_for_review INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (marked_for_review IN (0,1)), source_revealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (source_revealed=0), reveal_timestamp TEXT CHECK (reveal_timestamp IS NULL), presentation_order INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL, elapsed_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (elapsed_seconds >= 0), protocol_version TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, supersedes_annotation_id INTEGER REFERENCES gold_annotation_revisions(id), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(presented_record_id,reviewer_id,annotation_round,revision_number) )

indexes.name: idx_gold_arbitration_one_active
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_gold_arbitration_one_active ON gold_arbitration_revisions(corpus_id,corpus_paper_id) WHERE active=1

tables.name: gold_arbitration_revisions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_arbitration_revisions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, final_gold_label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( final_gold_label IN ('include','borderline','exclude') ), basis TEXT NOT NULL, arbitrator_id TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_version TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, supersedes_arbitration_id INTEGER REFERENCES gold_arbitration_revisions(id), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

tables.name: gold_corpora
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_corpora ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_version TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('building','frozen')), source_database_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, source_manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, sample_plan_json TEXT NOT NULL, sample_plan_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, corpus_manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, corpus_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, paper_count INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_at TEXT )

tables.name: gold_corpus_papers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_corpus_papers ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, gold_paper_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL, canonical_doi TEXT, fallback_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, original_title TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_title TEXT NOT NULL, abstract TEXT, abstract_length INTEGER NOT NULL, abstract_quality_status TEXT NOT NULL, journal TEXT NOT NULL, journal_short_name TEXT NOT NULL, issn TEXT, publication_date TEXT, publication_year INTEGER, authors_json TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_provenance_summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_links_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_record_timestamp TEXT, sampling_stratum TEXT NOT NULL, stratum_population_size INTEGER NOT NULL, inclusion_probability REAL NOT NULL CHECK ( inclusion_probability > 0 AND inclusion_probability <= 1 ), duplicate_cluster_key TEXT NOT NULL, content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(corpus_id,gold_paper_id), UNIQUE(corpus_id,source_paper_id) )

tables.name: gold_duplicate_cluster_members
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_duplicate_cluster_members ( cluster_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_duplicate_clusters(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(cluster_id,corpus_paper_id) )

tables.name: gold_duplicate_clusters
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_duplicate_clusters ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, cluster_uid TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('confirmed','candidate','not_duplicate')), basis_json TEXT NOT NULL, reviewed_by TEXT, reviewed_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(corpus_id,cluster_uid) )

tables.name: gold_governance_snapshots
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_governance_snapshots ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, snapshot_version TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, corpus_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_version TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, split_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'frozen' CHECK (status='frozen'), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(corpus_id,snapshot_version) )

tables.name: gold_holdout_evaluations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_holdout_evaluations ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_governance_snapshots(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, candidate_bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, split_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, result_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, evaluated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(snapshot_id,candidate_bundle_sha256) )

indexes.name: idx_gold_pilot_one_active_lease
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_gold_pilot_one_active_lease ON gold_pilot_leases(pilot_run_id) WHERE status='active'

tables.name: gold_pilot_leases
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_pilot_leases ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pilot_run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_pilot_runs_v2(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, owner_token TEXT NOT NULL, fencing_token INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','released','stale')), acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL, heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL )

tables.name: gold_pilot_results_v2
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_pilot_results_v2 ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pilot_run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_pilot_runs_v2(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, paper_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, model_provider TEXT, model_name TEXT, prompt_version TEXT, prompt_sha256 TEXT, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, estimated_cost_microunits INTEGER, latency_ms INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('succeeded','failed')), raw_response_reference TEXT, parsed_result_json TEXT, failure_type TEXT, no_abstract INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (no_abstract IN (0,1)), limitations_json TEXT NOT NULL, label_blinded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (label_blinded=1), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(pilot_run_id,request_fingerprint) )

tables.name: gold_pilot_runs_v2
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_pilot_runs_v2 ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_governance_snapshots(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, candidate_runtime_config_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, split_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split_name IN ('development','calibration')), budget_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( status IN ('prepared','running','paused','completed','failed') ), label_blinded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (label_blinded=1), randomized_seed INTEGER NOT NULL, stats_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

tables.name: gold_presented_records
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_presented_records ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (annotation_round IN (1,2)), presented_record_id TEXT NOT NULL, presentation_order INTEGER NOT NULL, hidden_repeat INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hidden_repeat IN (0,1)), repeat_of_presented_record_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(corpus_id,reviewer_id,annotation_round,presented_record_id), UNIQUE(corpus_id,reviewer_id,annotation_round,presentation_order) )

tables.name: gold_review_queue
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_review_queue ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, queue_reason TEXT NOT NULL, source_annotation_id INTEGER REFERENCES gold_annotation_revisions(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open','resolved')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, resolved_at TEXT, UNIQUE(corpus_id,corpus_paper_id,queue_reason,status) )

tables.name: gold_set_adjudications
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_set_adjudications ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES gold_set_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, adjudicated_label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( adjudicated_label IN ('include','borderline','exclude','uncertain') ), adjudication_reason TEXT NOT NULL, adjudicator_id TEXT NOT NULL, adjudicated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

tables.name: gold_set_annotations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_set_annotations ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_set_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, review_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (review_round IN (1,2)), label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (label IN ('include','borderline','exclude','uncertain')), reviewer_note TEXT, chinese_title_shown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (chinese_title_shown IN (0,1)), ai_info_shown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ai_info_shown=0), marked_for_later INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (marked_for_later IN (0,1)), started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(gold_set_item_id,reviewer_id,review_round) )

tables.name: gold_set_deferrals
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_set_deferrals ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_set_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, review_round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (review_round IN (1,2)), deferred_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(gold_set_item_id,reviewer_id,review_round) )

tables.name: gold_set_items
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_set_items ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_sets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, source_paper_id INTEGER, doi TEXT, original_title TEXT NOT NULL, formal_chinese_title TEXT, original_abstract TEXT, authors_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', journal TEXT NOT NULL, journal_group TEXT NOT NULL, publication_date TEXT, keywords_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', subject_codes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', source_metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', stratum TEXT NOT NULL, difficulty_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', display_order_seed INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(gold_set_id,source_paper_id), UNIQUE(gold_set_id,doi) )

tables.name: gold_set_snapshots
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_set_snapshots ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_sets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, snapshot_version TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_version TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, item_count INTEGER NOT NULL, label_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_db_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, immutable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (immutable=1), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(gold_set_id,snapshot_version) )

tables.name: gold_sets
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_sets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, gold_set_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, name TEXT NOT NULL, profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_db_path TEXT NOT NULL, source_db_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, sampling_manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, annotation_version TEXT NOT NULL, review_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (review_mode IN ('dual_reviewer','single_reviewer_two_rounds')), minimum_round_interval_days INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ( 'sampling','annotating_round_1','annotating_round_2','adjudicating','frozen' )), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_at TEXT, snapshot_sha256 TEXT )

tables.name: gold_source_reveals
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_source_reveals ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, annotation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_annotation_revisions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, revealed_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(annotation_id,reviewer_id) )

tables.name: gold_split_assignments
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_split_assignments ( split_manifest_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_split_manifests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, corpus_paper_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpus_papers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, duplicate_cluster_uid TEXT NOT NULL, split_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split_name IN ('development','calibration','holdout')), gold_label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (gold_label IN ('include','borderline','exclude')), PRIMARY KEY(split_manifest_id,corpus_paper_id) )

tables.name: gold_split_manifests
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_split_manifests ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_corpora(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, split_version TEXT NOT NULL, random_seed INTEGER NOT NULL, strategy_json TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, frozen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (frozen=1), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(corpus_id,split_version) )

tables.name: model_bundle_candidates
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE model_bundle_candidates ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, candidate_version TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, gold_set_snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_set_snapshots(id), bundle_json TEXT NOT NULL, bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'candidate' CHECK (status='candidate'), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT CHECK (approved_at IS NULL) )

tables.name: pilot_results
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pilot_results ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pilot_run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pilot_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, snapshot_item_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT, succeeded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (succeeded IN (0,1)), failure_type TEXT, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, estimated_cost REAL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(pilot_run_id,request_fingerprint) )

tables.name: pilot_runs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pilot_runs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, gold_set_snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES gold_set_snapshots(id), model_bundle_version TEXT NOT NULL, config_bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, prompt_bundle_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, budget_json TEXT NOT NULL, stats_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','running','partial','completed','failed')), failure_summary TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations ( migration_id INTEGER NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, migration_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL, application_version TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version_before TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version_after TEXT NOT NULL, execution_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, success INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (success IN (0,1)), error_type TEXT, error_message TEXT, inferred INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (inferred IN (0,1)), inference_method TEXT, schema_fingerprint TEXT, source_manifest TEXT, database_profile TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(database_profile,migration_id) )

tables.name: source_verifications
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE source_verifications ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('ontology_concept','subject_code','journal')), entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_title TEXT NOT NULL, publisher_or_organization TEXT, source_url TEXT, accessed_at TEXT NOT NULL, verification_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( verification_status IN ('pending','verified','rejected','needs_revision') ), reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL, reviewer_note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile_id,entity_type,entity_id,source_type,source_title) )

triggers.name: prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_delete BEFORE DELETE ON gold_corpora WHEN OLD.status='frozen' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'frozen gold corpus is immutable'); END

triggers.name: prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_paper_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_paper_delete BEFORE DELETE ON gold_corpus_papers WHEN (SELECT status FROM gold_corpora WHERE id=OLD.corpus_id)='frozen' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'frozen gold corpus papers are immutable'); END

triggers.name: prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_paper_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_frozen_gold_corpus_paper_update BEFORE UPDATE ON gold_corpus_papers WHEN (SELECT status FROM gold_corpora WHERE id=OLD.corpus_id)='frozen' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'frozen gold corpus papers are immutable'); END

triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_gold_governance_snapshot_update BEFORE UPDATE ON gold_governance_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'gold governance snapshots are immutable'); END

triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_gold_snapshot_update BEFORE UPDATE ON gold_set_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'gold set snapshots are immutable'); END
